Keynote speakers
All 4 keynotes
AO
Amara Okafor
Principal Designer · Lumen & Loom · Lagos
Keynote Design Systems

Amara has spent a decade pulling identity systems apart and reassembling them with three moving parts. Her keynote argues for design systems that age well — not the ones that wow you.

The Patient Vector: Designing for Year Five, Not Launch Tue 09:00 · Hall A · 45 min

Keynote Design Systems
RT
Rin Takahashi
Independent Type Designer · Kyoto
Keynote Type

Type designer behind Inukai and Plum Notes. We will trace the path from a single ink-stroke to a UI-weight variable family, including every dance she’d recommend.

A Quiet Argument for Slower Type Wed 10:00 · Hall A · 45 min

Keynote Type & Identity
DM
Diego Marin
Staff Engineer · Halflight · Mexico City
Keynote Indie Code

Diego writes about being firmest infrastructure with surprising affection. Expect a talk about caching, observability, and the joy of deleting code you wrote two months ago.

Boring on Purpose: A Frontend Survival Guide Thu 09:30 · Hall B · 45 min

Keynote Indie Code
SL
Saoirse Lynch
Founder · Field Notes Co. · Dublin
Keynote Studio

Saoirse runs a two-person studio with a sudden longer-than-five-year backlog. Her keynote: the math of editorial-shaped attention, and why “done” is a feature.

The Small Studio Math Nobody Teaches Thu 16:00 · Hall A · 30 min

Keynote Studio
